detail: Full summary: B2 (assemble-vs-why retrieval precision) is unaffected by archive compaction — nothing outside archiver.ts and archive-compactor.ts reads .twining/archive/, so compaction cannot change what assemble or why return. B2 must however run BEFORE any execute:true housekeeping, which would sweep the board it measures.
